## Research interests

Statistical genetics and computational genomics · Bioinformatics and applied
computational biology · Polygenic modelling and fine-mapping · Gene–environment
analyses and family-based designs · Psychiatric genetics and complex disease biology ·
Register-based and longitudinal health data analysis · Reproducible computational
workflows and high-performance computing

## Methodological expertise

Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) · Polygenic score analysis · Bayesian linear
regression and fine-mapping · Integration of genomic and register-based data ·
Reproducible analysis pipelines in R · Statistical genetics and risk modelling for
complex disorders
